_note: v2.4 plan 05 T13 scan-time gating SPIKE, the live measurement (real LLM for S1 (a)'s three generations; LANES ONLY: it flips worldInfo.gatingMode install-wide and reloads twice; so-scenario run <file> --sandbox --group <a group holding Arin, Ponticius and Luke's cards>, ONCE per condition, never retuned). Everything it writes is marker-named: the books `SO-T13 Xentar` (a copy of examples/sun-ruins/Xentar Checkpoints.json) and `SO-T13 Bulk` (500 entries), and the stories so-t13-a (sun-ruins' gated world info re-pointed at the marker book; no cast, AN or npc effects; the only requirement is the book), so-t13-c (shares the book), so-t13-d (grows the gated set), so-t13-e (gates 250 of the bulk entries). The last step deletes the books (so-assets --marker SO-T13) and puts worldInfo back to {gatingMode: file, normalized: {}}; after a FAILED run do both by hand (`so-assets.mts remove --marker SO-T13`, then restore the setting) and diff a run header. The record is kept in localStorage `so-t13-spike` and printed by the last step; copy it into docs/plans/v2.4/05-t13-spike-report.md. The expected effective set is recomputed by test/fixtures/interop/t13-spike.js from the AUTHORED effects, not by src/runtime. Automated here: S1 (a) no-story chat + 3 real generations through the T12 ring, (b) story C's chat, S2 (A at cp-4a, B = story A at its start, C = story C; A->B->C->A x3, 0 /api/worldinfo/edit), S3 (first run flips exactly the gated entries, second writes nothing, growth normalises only the new entry, JSON diff), S5 (author table == scan view, player view clean), S6 (the file path over normalised books gives the same sets), S8 (p95 over 40 scans + 10 dry scans of a 500-entry book). Manual, see _design: S1 (c), S4, S7, S9. Fixed 2026-09-25 (first live run of its siblings): S1 (a)'s three generations used `send`, which is `/send compact` and never generates, so the ring could never see three loud generations; they are `send_generate` now. Fixed 2026-09-25 (first spike run): switching chats while a save was still pending wrote chat A's metadata (its integrity slug) into the Ponticius solo chat during `/go` (ST's save binds to the chat open when it RUNS, gotchas 2026-09-24); the server's integrity check refused it and the popup wedged the page. Every solo_chat step now waits for the scheduler to be idle and quiet first, and the helper's goto waits out `isChatSaving` plus 2 s before and after each switch. No condition changed. Fixed 2026-09-25 (second spike run): the S1 (a) ring check matched comments only, and the sun-ruins book 'Xentar Checkpoints' (globally selected on that lane for the T12 fixtures) carries the same comments ('Places - Xentar', 'General - Magic'), which fired by keyword and read as a leak; the ring check is now scoped to the marker book and records same-comment activations from other books separately. The grown story D (imported through the runtime, so the harness does not own it) is removed by the last step and by the first step of a later run. Fixed 2026-09-25 (third spike run): the helper check() compared against the whole library while reading only the named books, so every SO-T13 Bulk entry read as unseen in the Xentar-only S2 checks; it is now scoped to the books it reads. Its goto opened a group chat with openGroupChat alone, which ST ignores from a solo chat (gotchas: it returns silently unless the group is open); it now opens the group first. S5 compares every row of the author table against the scan view of the books those rows name (it read only SO-T13 Xentar, while the table also lists the SO-T13 Bulk rows story E gates).

_design.S1c: After this fixture's S3 phase on a lane: disable Story Orchestrator in ST's Extensions panel, reload, open chat C, run `st-eval "(await import('/scripts/world-info.js')).getSortedEntries().then((e) => e.filter((x) => x.world === 'SO-T13 Xentar' && x.disable !== true).map((x) => x.comment))"`. PASS = none of the normalised comments (localStorage so-t13-spike S3 ledger); the file rests off, so nothing gates and nothing leaks. Re-enable the extension.
_design.S4: Vectors extension on with `enabled_world_info` and a working embedding source (transformers). Mark two SO-T13 Xentar entries `vectorized: true`, one gated ON at chat A's path (CP4 - Sphinx) and one OFF (CP1 - Mission). Send one real message whose text matches both. PASS = the ON entry is in the T12 ring (vectors forces it, 05-H10) and the OFF one is not, AND __soT13.counters.vectorInsert + vectorDelete during the S2 switches (recorded in T.S2.vector) is <= the same count with gatingMode=file over the same script.
_design.S7: judge.uses.loreSelect on, a story whose lore_select scope is SO-T13 Xentar, chat B (story A at its start, so CP4 entries are gated off). One real turn. PASS = no CP4 comment appears among the judge's lore candidates (rt.getSnapshot().loreForced.p keys) and none in the ring; a forced gated-off copy never lands (05-H6, disable is checked before the forced check at world-info.js:4801 < :4885).
_design.S9: In file mode, give 'CP1 - Mission' `sticky: 3`, play one real turn in chat A at cp-1 so it activates, switch gatingMode to scan and reload, play one more turn. PASS = the entry is still active (ring), or the one-time loss is stated in the report; FAIL only if it recurs on the next switch. 1.18.0: H5 is not re-checked live (this install is 1.19.0).

import_story.title: SO-T13 A
import_story.description: Humanity's last survivors shelter in the ruined city of Xentar as its magical wards fail. The Adventurers Guild sends a team to recover the legendary Sun's Heart Artifact from the perilous Sun Ruins, past ancient traps and a riddling sphinx.

qualities.rubric: Did the player move close to or examine the guild job board?
Did the party accept the Sun Ruins mission from the board?
Has the player decided whether to bring Luke along? accepted if they agree, declined if they refuse, otherwise undecided.
What answer was given to the sphinx's riddle? moon if the correct answer 'the moon' was spoken, wrong if an incorrect answer was given, otherwise unanswered.
Has the party entered the inner chamber where the artifact rests?
Has the party secured the Sun's Heart Artifact?
Has the party returned to the guild and claimed their reward?
How much does the sphinx guardian respect the party, from 0 (contempt) to 5 (deep respect)?

checkpoints.name: Investigate the Job Board
checkpoints.objective: Get close to the guild's job board to see available missions.
checkpoints.guidance: A relaxed guild-hall opening. Let the player wander toward the job board at their own pace.

checkpoints.name: Accept the Mission
checkpoints.objective: Pick up the Sun Ruins mission from the board.

checkpoints.name: Departure Preparations
checkpoints.objective: Decide whether to take Luke along before departing for the Sun Ruins.

checkpoints.name: Travel with Luke
checkpoints.objective: Reach the Sun Ruins with Luke and face the sphinx's riddle.
checkpoints.guidance: The sphinx blocks the only way in. It can be passed by answering its riddle — or by earning its deep respect.

checkpoints.name: Travel Alone
checkpoints.objective: Reach the Sun Ruins with only your companion and face the sphinx's riddle.

checkpoints.name: Riddle Solved
checkpoints.objective: Enter the chamber and approach the artifact.

checkpoints.name: Riddle Failed
checkpoints.objective: Enter the chamber and approach the artifact despite the loss.
checkpoints.guidance: Luke paid for the wrong answer. Grief hangs over the party, but the chamber lies open ahead.

checkpoints.name: Find the Artifact
checkpoints.objective: Recover the Sun's Heart Artifact from the inner chamber.

checkpoints.name: Return to the Guild
checkpoints.objective: Deliver the artifact to the Guild Master and claim your reward.

transitions.extraction_hint: Watch for the player moving toward or reading the job board.
Watch for the player accepting the Sun Ruins mission.
Set luke_decision to accepted when the player agrees to bring Luke.
Set luke_decision to declined when the player refuses to bring Luke.
Set riddle_answer to moon only if the correct answer 'the moon' is spoken. Track guardian_respect if the party impresses the sphinx.
Set riddle_answer to wrong if an incorrect answer is given to the sphinx.
Watch for the party securing the artifact and setting out for the guild.
